about_the_game:
Welcome to Soulblaze!

Grab your bindshards, pet your animons, and go on an adventure. This game is a creature collecting and dice rolling roguelite. Fight your way through several regions and beat their bosses, build your team as you go, find consumables, teach your creatures tricks, and become the strongest animancer!

Features

  • capture and train unique hand-drawn creatures that each have their own passive ability

  • combat hybrid between classic creature-collecting RPGs and TTRPG dice-roll mechanics

  • upgrade and customize techniques by combining tags to create your own individual builds

  • 90s-retro + fantasy: flashdrives, sticker albums, and magic, baby!

  • Twitch integration

Bite-Sized Creature Collecting

Enjoy the fun of picking a starter and building your team without having to commit dozents of hours. Runs are fast-paced and always different, each of your teams unique every time. You won't run out of action points, you won't have to walk to the last healing provider over and over, you just keep going... until you win? Yes, win!

Progression

With each run, you collect marbles that you can spend on permanent upgrades that enhances your animons, gives you more options during a run, unlocks starters and more. Who knows, maybe one day you can hatch special animons this way, too?!

Twitch Integration

Let your viewers interact with the game. They can suggest which path to take, spend channel points to give you rewards, predict enemy moves, and even bid on animons to permanently adopt them across streams.

Solo-Dev

Soulblaze is being created by a single person who grew up loving creature collecting games. This is a passion project of combining their joy of cute little critters, roguelites, and dice-rolling into one package.

Accessibility Tags

Visual Features

  • Color Alternatives

 

Auditory Features

  • Multiple Volume Controls

  • Narrated Menus

  • Stereo Sound

 

Input Features

  • Playable with Buttons Only

  • Playable with Keyboard Only

  • Playable with Mouse Only

  • Playable without Button Holds

  • Playable without Rapid Button Presses

 

Read more about the Accessible Games Initiative on their website.
